title: Pod Security Standards i Secreti
summary: Pod Security Standards i Pod Security Admission, securityContext koji prolazi restricted nivo, ko sve može pročitati Secret i kako uključiti i provjeriti enkripciju Secreta u etcd-u.
summary_en: Pod Security Standards and Pod Security Admission, a securityContext that passes the restricted level, who can read a Secret, and how to enable and verify Secret encryption in etcd.
